notes.title: 【 Gifts a luxurious gift package worth 500 】 Enjoy good reviews and gifts
notes.notes:
Comment on "Three Kingdoms: I am the Lord" in Steam to receive a luxurious gift package worth 500 yuan
Gift package content: 8 camp recruitment orders, 2 level 6 equipment gemstones, 200 white tiger stones, 100 training symbols, 10 locking symbols, and 200 forging stones

Official player group: 662646712
Gift Pack Collection Method: Private Chat Customer Service Xiao K can provide screenshots of comments to collect (limited to once per person)
